title: Protect host audio stream lifetimes before raw SDK submission
goal: Provide original bounded host owner/session admission so closed audio tokens cannot reach a reused raw SDK stream, without revising the SDK ABI or admitting guest services.
acceptance: Define a standalone C++20 eight-stream ownership gate with opaque instance/session-bound tokens and explicit nonzero host owner IDs; reject invalid, closed, moved, foreign-instance and wrong-owner commands before any backend call, including raw-ID reuse

Serialize public operations on the creating host thread; SDK callbacks only record bounded per-binding credits through detached lifetime state, never reenter a backend or call arbitrary clients. Old callbacks cannot credit a replacement, and exhaustion fails diagnostically without wrapping identifiers/counters

Use an explicit narrow backend port, preserve backend refusal/errors and earlier valid owners on ordinary failure, bound frame spans to the established original host PCM shape, and release owned streams on close/owner-close/shutdown without per-submit ownership allocations or PCM copies

Prove admission against the actual unchanged approved SDK in explicit timer and SDL dummy modes: retain the raw stale-ID baseline, reject that stale host token before SDK Submit, and show the replacement/other owner still progresses with correct cleanup

Keep SDK-specific glue in the diagnostic lane; no shared SDK/profile, input, allocation, startup, existing runtime interface, guest ABI, profile authentication or title playback change. Any production integration or broader interface change requires a separate agreed task
validation: Run original positive/negative native contracts on Windows/Linux, including partial-open/submit failure, active raw-ID collision, close/reopen, owner/instance isolation, delayed callbacks, bounded exhaustion, frame bounds and wrong-thread calls; distinguish model faults from actual SDK observations

Run supported public-core and SDK-facing host sanitizers, actual SDK isolated/repeated/reordered cases, strict nonce/library/result controls and resource recovery; identify uninstrumented library coverage and physical/title checks not run

Measure token admission/submission/callback progress over at least three independent comparable processes, retain tails and correctness work, run public checks, and publish exact source/compiler/package/library/binary identities with material limits
size: bounded original host lifetime gate plus actual-SDK diagnostic bridge; no shared ABI repair or title binding
